behaviour: Frees the ID registry when it becomes empty but does not set the global pointer at 0x99a67c to null. GetTGObjectPtr does not check that pointer.
fix_note: Set the global to null after the free.

behaviour: On the replace path the copy ends with reference count 2: Duplicate sets 1 (E0063) and SetProperty adds 1 (E0089). The instance holds one reference, so the destructor leaves the copy alive with count 1.
fix_note: Do not call IncRefCount in SetProperty on this path, or lower the count of the copy after the call. Check the intended ownership first: SetProperty from other callers may need the increment.

behaviour: Reads the registry pointer at 0x99a67c and calls through its vtable with no null check. A call before the first TGObject exists, or after B0001 freed the registry, uses a null or freed registry.
fix_note: Check the pointer for null and return 0.

behaviour: Reads the fields of its argument through the result of Cast, which is null when the argument is not a SubsystemProperty. No test for null follows the call, so the first read (0x692733) faults. The source has the same read.
fix_note: Test the result of Cast for null and return 0.

behaviour: Calls DecRefCount on the property at +0xc without a test for null. The constructor stores the Duplicate result there, and Duplicate returns 0 when the class factory table has no creator for the type, so the destructor reads address 8 and faults.
fix_note: Test the property for null before the call.

behaviour: When the argument is already in the list, FindByNameAndType returns the argument. The function unlinks it, calls DecRefCount on it and appends the same pointer. At the count 1 the template is deleted and the list holds the deleted object.
fix_note: Compare the found template with the argument and skip the unlink and the release when they are equal.

behaviour: When the engine function returns 0 the wrapper returns None without raising its reference count. The engine function returns 0 only for the level -0x3fda939c. The generated code for a string result keeps the path.
fix_note: Raise the count of None with Py_INCREF before the return.

behaviour: When no fromlist is given, the result of PyTuple_New (0x74da90) is not tested for NULL. The next calls are PyString_FromString (0x7506c0) and PyTuple_SetItem (0x74db90) with that result. After an out-of-memory failure the code reads the type of a NULL pointer (0x74db90 reads [tuple+4]) and crashes. The string result is also not tested. Stock builtin___import__ has no such code.
fix_note: Test the tuple and the string for NULL and return NULL.

behaviour: With the securelevel counter above 0, the function does not parse its arguments. The mode string keeps its default value 'r' (0x8d9b74), so the searches for '+', 'w' and 'a' never succeed. Every open() call raises IOError 'Securelevel prevents file IO.' (0x9620b0), also for reading and also for bad arguments. The message 'Securelevel prevents file writing.' (0x96208c) cannot be reached.
fix_note: Parse the arguments first, then test the mode string. Decide in the modernization stage if reading must stay allowed.

function: posix_mkdir and the two-path helper of posix_rename (module nt)
behaviour: When the path check 0x76d790 rejects the path, the functions return NULL and do not set an exception. The calling interpreter loop sees an error return with no exception object. Other nt functions raise an error (listdir: ValueError 'not allowed') or return 0 (access).
fix_note: Raise an exception (for example the same ValueError 'not allowed' as listdir) before the return.

behaviour: The folder check tests only that the full path starts with <cwd>\Custom or <cwd>\scripts\Custom. The prefix has no trailing separator, so a folder <cwd>\CustomX also passes. The file check 0x76d790 uses the prefix with a trailing separator.
fix_note: Add the trailing separator to the prefix, as the file check does.

behaviour: When a cast entry moves to the front of the list the code does not set the prev field of the entry. The field keeps the old predecessor. A later move of the same entry, after another entry moved in front of it, takes the entry out through the old predecessor. The list can then lose entries.
fix_note: Set the prev field of the moved entry to the type entry after the move.

behaviour: When the text has more than 24 digits, the code tests whether digit number 24 (index 23, at [EBP-0x45]) is 5 or more and then adds 1 to digit 24. The rounding digit is digit 25 (index 24). The 25th digit is dropped without being used. Example: 9007199254740993.500000005 gives the double 0x4340000000000000 (the digit 24 is 0).
fix_note: Test the digit at index 24 and add the carry to the digit at index 23.

behaviour: The tie test for the rounding to 53 bits leaves out the bit that follows the round bit, and when the test says tie the number is cut down (no round to even). So an exact half and a half with a bit set just behind it both round down. Examples: 9007199254740993.5 gives 9007199254740992.0 and 9007199254740995 gives ...994.
fix_note: Test all bits behind the round bit, round up when any of them is set, and round to even on an exact half.

behaviour: The conversion of a double to the extended number gives a zero without the sign for a double zero. So -0.0 prints as 0 in all formats (the text has no minus sign).
fix_note: Keep the sign word for a zero.

behaviour: The 17 digits are made by a multiplication that drops low words and by 18 steps of a 96-bit register; the 18th digit rounds half up. The digits are not always the correctly rounded ones: 229845068883170.375 prints as 229845068883170.37 with %.17g, and exact halves round up (8.225440979003906e-06 as 8.2254409790039063e-06).
fix_note: Make the digits from the exact binary value and round half to even.

behaviour: A result in the denormal range gets the underflow code 2 from _ld12tod, so strtod returns 0.0 with errno 0x22 for texts such as 5e-324, while atof returns the denormal value.
fix_note: Return the denormal value and set errno only when the result is zero.

behaviour: The digit text has at most 17 significant digits. A %f result with more digits has zeros behind them (66926478731690.96 prints as 66926478731690.961000). A %f of an infinity or a NaN cuts the text 1#INF to the digits that the precision allows and rounds the last one (%.2f gives 1.#J).
fix_note: Make as many digits as the format asks for.

behaviour: Divide with one IDIV. -2147483648 divided by -1 (also the remainder, and the divisions of int_pow) raises the hardware exception of IDIV: the exe crashes. Other cases give the exact quotient, for example -2147483648 / 2 is -1073741824.
fix_note: Test for the overflow case and raise OverflowError.

behaviour: int(NaN) raises OverflowError 'float too large to convert' because FCOM sets C0 for an unordered compare.
fix_note: Raise a clearer error or a value error for a NaN.

behaviour: A null name (Python None) or a group without a name is compared byte by byte without a test. When the list or the array has an entry, the read at address 0 stops the exe.
fix_note: Test the pointers for null before the compare.

behaviour: An icon number that has a location keeps its node and gets the new location. The old location is not freed and keeps its reference to the texture property.
fix_note: Free the old location with its reference in the table (ClearNode).

behaviour: The texture handle indexes the array without a test. A handle from used up to the capacity gives a null property and SetIconLocation reads through it; a handle beyond the capacity reads outside the block.
fix_note: Test the handle against used and raise an error.

behaviour: GetNext reads the node at 0x99d48c without a test. After GoToFirstPos of a group without icons, after the last icon, or after the group was deleted, the read of address 0 (or of a freed node) stops the exe. One variable serves all groups.
fix_note: Keep the iterator in the group and test it; give a value at the end.

behaviour: A group that has the name of a loaded group is not added and is not freed. The object stays allocated with no owner.
fix_note: Free the group or return a result.

behaviour: The functions divide by the screen width or height of the manager without a test. The start value is 0, so the result is an infinity or a NaN until SetDisplayInfo or SetScreenWidth and SetScreenHeight run.
fix_note: Give 0 when the screen size is 0.

behaviour: A file that did not load (0x7e0c50 gives null) is put into the texture cache with a null texture. Later calls for the same path find the node and give -1 without a new try.
fix_note: Do not enter a failed load into the cache.

behaviour: A null name, module or function (Python None) stops the exe: the constructor reads the length with REPNE SCASB at address 0.
fix_note: Test the texts for null in the wrapper or keep the null.

behaviour: The code reads the second character of the file name before it knows the length. For the empty text it reads the byte behind the terminator.
fix_note: Test the first character first.

behaviour: The working directory and the file name are copied into a buffer of 0x100 bytes on the stack without a length test. A long name writes over the stack. The source stops at the exe address when the text does not fit.
fix_note: Test the length or use a longer buffer.

behaviour: For a colour mapped file whose colour map entries have 32 bits, the loader copies the first entry of the colour map (the bytes at 0x9a2e44) to every pixel. The reader without alpha (0x8254e0) uses the index of the pixel.
fix_note: Index the colour map with the pixel value.

behaviour: The packet counters of the run length types (0x9b2e4c and 0x9b2e50) are not set to 0 at the start of a file. A file that ended inside a packet leaves the rest of the packet to the next file; the next file then takes its first pixels from that packet.
fix_note: Set both counters to 0 when the type is read.

behaviour: A colour mapped file with 16 bit indices can give an index of 0x4000 or more. The reader without alpha reads the colour map outside its 0x4000 entries. The source stops at the exe address.
fix_note: Refuse an index past the last entry of the map.

behaviour: A file of the types 2, 3, 10 or 11 that has a colour map whose entry size is not 8, 15, 16, 24 or 32 makes the loader store the values that earlier instructions left in registers for each entry. The values depend on the address of the raw image. The source stops at the exe address.
fix_note: Refuse the entry size of a colour map in a file that does not use it.

behaviour: The loader copies the path (without the prefix 'file://') into a buffer of 256 bytes on the stack without a length test. A longer path writes over the stack. The source stops at the exe address.
fix_note: Test the length or use a longer buffer.

behaviour: An image that is not a NiDDImage makes the renderer give null to the texture manager. 0x7d6f30 passes null as the object of 0x7c6370, which reads the flags of the image at null +0x24 and stops. The source stops at the exe address 0x7c6370.
fix_note: Refuse an image that is not a NiDDImage.

behaviour: The function reads the slot of the format table with the mask of the image as the index before it tests the index. A mask below 0 uses a value from outside the table. A mask above 7 is read and then ignored. The source stops at the exe address for a mask below 0.
fix_note: Test the mask before the read.

behaviour: The palette object that CreatePalette makes for a paletted surface is not released after SetPalette. The reference stays for the life of the process.
fix_note: Release the palette object after SetPalette.

behaviour: The destructor of a font family record frees the name and the blocks of its two lists. It does not free the registration records (0x14 bytes and three copied texts each) and it does not delete the font groups. The manager destructor runs at exit, so the records stay allocated at exit.
fix_note: Free the records and delete the groups before the blocks.

behaviour: The name of the icon group (family name and size with two decimals) is written with sprintf into a stack buffer of 0x80 bytes without a length test. A text of 128 characters or more writes over the saved exception link. The source stops at the exe address when the text does not fit.
fix_note: Use a buffer that fits the name, or test the length.

behaviour: A null name (Python None) is compared byte by byte with the family names without a test. When the list has a family, the read at address 0 stops the exe. With an empty list the family record is made with a null name and the constructor 0x747990 stops (B0028).
fix_note: Test the name for null in the wrapper.
